resources.string: Keeps the home screen, colours and messages card in a file you choose, for example in Downloads or on Google Drive. Load the file again after a reset or on a new phone.
The same for every Senior app on this phone in one file: home screen, phone, alarms and Back & Home bar. The lock and its PIN are never saved.
